radiusSource: Radius 1.0072 +/- 0.0169 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 6061 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 700,709 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.0269 +/- 0.0317 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 6061 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
